title: Cape Reinga Tour Review
meta_desc: Honest review of Cape Reinga and Ninety Mile Beach Tour, a great family day trip in Northland, NZ. Get insider tips, prices and age suitability.
intro: The Cape Reinga and Ninety Mile Beach Tour is a must-do for many NZ families. But what's it really like with kids? We share our honest review, including prices, age suitability and insider tips. The tour costs $99 per adult and $70 per child, and lasts around 9-10 hours.

sections.heading: What to Expect
sections.body:
The Cape Reinga day tour from Pahia or Kaitaia is an action-packed adventure that's sure to thrill both kids and adults. You'll drive along Ninety Mile Beach, stop at the Te Paki sand dunes for sandboarding, and walk to Cape Reinga lighthouse where the Tasman Sea meets the Pacific Ocean.

The tour is suitable for kids aged 5+, but be aware that the long drive times and busy schedule might be challenging for younger children. We recommend this tour for families with kids aged 7+.

Despite the potential downsides, the stunning scenery and unique experiences make this tour an unforgettable experience for families.
list: Sandboarding at Te Paki sand dunes

sections.heading: Value for Money
sections.body:
The tour costs $99 per adult and $70 per child, which is reasonable considering the unique experiences and stunning scenery. However, be aware that you'll need to factor in additional costs for food and snacks throughout the day.

Overall, we think the tour is good value for money, but families on a tight budget might want to consider packing their own lunch and snacks to save costs.

sections.heading: Insider Tips
sections.body:
To make the most of your tour, we recommend booking early to secure your preferred departure date. You should also pack plenty of water, sunscreen, and snacks, as well as comfortable shoes and clothing for the walk to Cape Reinga lighthouse.

Additionally, consider visiting during the shoulder season (April-May or September-October) to avoid the crowds and enjoy milder weather.

sections.heading: Booking and Saving Money
sections.body:
To book the Cape Reinga and Ninety Mile Beach Tour, simply visit the tour operator's website or contact them directly. You can also check for special deals and discounts on their social media pages or by signing up to their newsletter.

Some tour operators may offer discounts for large families or groups, so be sure to ask about these when booking.
